evidence: All discrete poses have bounded static forces; some linear interiors do not. Soft state-driven references with constrained real simulated dynamics, not a forced feasible trajectory.
floor_front_reference: Grounded compact floor start; retained first FR transfer and actual credit gate; FL pre-edge lift/crossing has 10 mm full-foot clearance, then flattens and plants. Discrete static targets; connecting motion unproven.
rear_reference: 105 static candidates; rear-foot connecting path and support flattening remain unproven.
pitch_mapping: Within guided variants, normalized command is b+(1-b)*a for a>=0, b+(1+b)*a otherwise. b is reference pitch/110 deg. a=-1/+1 retains full -110/+110 deg range. Existing filter, IK and motor guards remain.

front_reset_static_load.assumption: specified stance corners, friction pyramid, bounded PD setpoint headroom

combined_experiment: Exact-IK baseline with revised second-front reference only; same reward, controller, reset distribution, robot, stair geometry and physical success gates

front_final_loaded_landing.assumption: specified stance corners, friction pyramid, bounded PD setpoint headroom

endpoint_change: Compact floor reset and complete first-front reference replace prior spread-out front route; rear/free branches, assistance and load-transfer reward retained

second_front_final_loaded.assumption: specified stance corners, friction pyramid, bounded PD setpoint headroom

second_tread_scope: Append accepted discrete FL lift/cross/tilted-touchdown poses after actual first-stage hold. Connections unproven; no new reset. Guided completion is a separately logged loaded tilted touchdown, never flat plant or full-climb success.
floor_rear_transfer_scope: After measured floor-start front-pair hold,14 static grounded load-shift poses aim for rear-left contact norm<3N. Then the ordinary2s reference fade lets RL try takeoff. No rear-foot credit or first-stage success is granted by this guidance milestone.
floor_rear_transfer_preload_source: Exact constrained vertex_force_n and limb gravity; independent_load is only an unconstrained alternative-force feasibility diagnostic.
